title: Resumable GribStream Runs Client and Raw Landing Zone
mission: Implement the reusable authenticated client, request planner, selector resolver, chunker, retry/quota logic, raw landing, normalization and manifests used by every model acquisition task.
steps: Use official Python client or direct HTTP while preserving exact payloads.
Use /runs for backfill; support timeseries only for controlled operational convenience.
Canonicalize request JSON and derive request SHA-256.
Support coordinate and grid requests, ensemble members, expressions, filters, min/max lead.
Stream NDJSON/gzip to immutable object files while computing checksum and row count.
Normalize forecasted_at to run_time_utc and forecasted_time to valid_time_utc; compute lead_minutes.
Implement resumable state machine and bounded retries.
acceptance: Same request never creates duplicate values
All values preserve exact selector/run/valid/member lineage
failure: Catalog selector change: stop affected semantic variable and require new selector snapshot
